preconditions.description: The total number of rounds n is equal to the sum of Alice's rock, scissors, and paper plays.
The total number of rounds n is equal to the sum of Bob's rock, scissors, and paper plays.
The number of rounds n is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of times Alice shows rock a1 is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of times Alice shows scissors a2 is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of times Alice shows paper a3 is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of times Bob shows rock b1 is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of times Bob shows scissors b2 is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of times Bob shows paper b3 is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of rounds Alice can win is between 0 and n inclusive.
The maximum number of rounds Alice can win is between 0 and n inclusive.
The minimum number of rounds Alice can win is less than or equal to the maximum number of rounds Alice can win.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == min(a1 - b2, a2 - b3, a3 - b1) + max(0, min(a1 - b2, a2 - b3, a3 - b1) + min(a1 - b3, a2 - b1, a3 - b2))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of rounds Alice can win is calculated based on the given rules.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1] == min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)
postconditions.description: The maximum number of rounds Alice can win is calculated based on the given rules.
